predecessors.name: Twenty-ninth Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: all of Egypt: 'Nectanebo I had gained control of all of Egypt by November of 380 BC'

successors.name: Achaemenid Empire
successors.text: Egypt, lost to Artaxerxes III's second invasion in 343 BC ('Succeeded by: Thirty-first Dynasty of Egypt', the Persian kings as pharaohs); the Libyan coast in the shape is not mentioned on the pages

ledger.x: 380 BC: Nectanebo I ends the Twenty-ninth Dynasty and rules all of Egypt.
343 BC: Artaxerxes III invades Egypt a second time.
343 BC: the fighting ends with Nectanebo II's flight.

The Libyan coast in Cliopatria's shape goes with the dynasty's end; neither page opened mentions Cyrene, Libya or Sinai, so the holder and the year are bridging (Cliopatria's Achaemenid shape of -337 holds Cyrenaica).
343 BC: the last native dynasty of Egypt ends.

wars.name: Teos' invasion of Persian Syria and Israel
wars.outcome: The page gives no result beyond Teos losing his throne 'due to the machinations of his own brother Tjahapimu'.

wars.name: Artaxerxes III's first invasion of Egypt
wars.outcome: Failed: 'Artaxerxes then attempted an unsuccessful invasion of Egypt in the winter of 351/350 BC'.

wars.name: Second Achaemenid conquest of Egypt
wars.outcome: Persian victory: Nectanebo II withdrew from the Delta to Memphis and fled south to Nubia; the Thirtieth Dynasty ended.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line on the pages opened; the Delta, Sinai, Nubian and Libyan edges are approximate, and the Libyan coast in the Cliopatria shape is unverified.
